messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: pattern of mid-stream timeouts and partial responses keeps recurring. We need owners for server keepalive/resume, client retry/resume, metrics, and runbook. Short plan?

ajay: I'll own server changes. Plan: emit 8s keepalives, avoid closing until final ack, add resume token on last chunk. Spike by Tue.

tara: I'll add metrics and alerts. Will create `partial_response_rate`, `last_chunk_gap_ms` histogram, and `resume_attempts_total`. Dashboard by tomorrow.

kyle: I'll own client behavior. Implement jittered exponential backoff, cap at 3 retries, and support `X-Stream-Resume`. PR by Thu.

oncall-sre: I'll update runbook with detection queries, mitigation steps (increase keepalive, flip to resume-ready pool), and pager rules. Will push in 48h.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created INF-3030: "stream-silence remediation". Assignees: ajay, tara, kyle, oncall-sre.

ajay: Canary plan: staging -> us-west-2. Acceptance: partials <0.05% for 48h and resume_success_rate >98%.

tara: Alert: page if partial_rate >0.2% for 10m or resume_fail_rate >10% for 15m. Dashboard link (temp): https://grafana.company/d/xyz/stream-health.

kyle: Client rollout: feature-flag 5% -> 25% -> 100% with debug headers to trace resume flows.

maria: Daily 15m check-ins for the next week. I'll update INF-3030 with PRs and canary notes. If blocked, ping here. :thumbsup:
